title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Wow, you've got it worse than me, and I'm an idol. Here I thought my schedule was rough... Alright, cross this out, and this out... Don't thank me, you've gotta rest hard to work hard!

title: Talk 1
original: Back in my debut days, I had to print my own posters, alter my own outfits, do everything myself to save money. But I mean, that taught me a bunch of practical skills, so... Hehe, look here, I embroidered a little finbeast into my own work sleeve. Isn't it super cute?

title: Talk 2
original: This pudding looks so good... My agency never used to let me eat pudding, but no one can stop me now—no, think healthy, Haruka, you've had enough sugar already—Doc, that's not an invite to eat it for me!

title: Talk 3
original: When I was growing up, adults loved to feed me ghost stories, so that stuff has always terrified me. And now ever since my debut, horror movies keep casting me 'cause they like how real my screams are... Mattaku-mou, that's the one thing I don't need validation for!

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Rhodes Island is really good at coverups. It's been days and the gossip rags still haven't hunted me down... Wait. I haven't faded away, have I? There's no way I'm old news already! Oh, this is bad, I'm gonna head back tomorrow!

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: This photo's from after we wrapped my first movie, I'm posing here with all the locals. Yeah, in Kajimachi... Maybe once I've hit up enough cities, held enough performances, then I'll catch sight of them again one day, somewhere in my sea of cheering fans. That's what I believe.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Finbeasts are so cute, seriously. I love the gold glittering ornamental ones. Putting them in those little bags of water, holding them up to the sun, watching them blow out bubbles. Like this, *pop*, *pop*—blah, I can't talk and pout at the same time!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Last night, I dreamt I was on a cushion of bubbles lifting me into the sky, and I could see home fall further away with every gust. And it was like, I know I'm gonna fall eventually, but it's so pretty up here in the sky, so I had to keep on flying and flying, as hard as I could, even if at some point I was just blowing the bubbles myself... 'cause I wanna keep flying.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: My memory's never been that good, but the nerves I get from being in front of my bosses make my head go white. But technically, you're my boss too, right? So I wonder why you don't make me... um! I mean, what I mean to say is, don't start intimidating me or anything, 'cause I'll... I'll, uh—I might, um... sorry, what I was gonna, uh... *groan*...

title: Idle
original: C'mon, fall asleep already... I won't feel hungry while I'm asleep... This is so unfair, how come the Doc conks out so easily?!

title: Onboard
original: Wait, okay, so a friend recommended me here, but before I sign anything, just let me read these contracts—okay, no crazy long-terms, no outrageous penalty fees... Doesn't look like a black company to me. Great, I'm ready to sign!

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Maybe we could mix a few of my concert tapes into this... Hey, wait, at least think about it!

title: Promotion 1
original: I can't believe how fast the promotion track here is! I took forever to go from training to debut, and I had to pay the agency for my classes the whole time… Ugh... When can Rhodes Island get into the idol biz?

title: Promotion 2
original: Now I can finally work alongside Hoshiguma! She helped me out so much back in Mitsukue, and I'm gonna make sure I don't drag her down anymore!

title: Added to Squad
original: Huh?! But idols need years of training just to go onstage! I don't have nearly enough combat hours to... A—Are you really sending me in?

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I dunno about commanding people, I think I'm more of a morale booster...

title: Depart
original: Doctor, what do I do if my legs are shaking...?

title: Begin Operation
original: Doctor, there's, there's enemies!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Last step of battlefield prep—deep breaths, in, in, in!

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Do we have time to go over combat techniques again...?

title: Deployment 1
original: I—I'll try and keep my eyes open!

title: Deployment 2
original: If I make it back in one piece, I win...

title: In Battle 1
original: Iai-giri! Wait, that's not a sword—aw, whatever, take this!

title: In Battle 2
original: If I'm dead anyway, I'm taking you with me!

title: In Battle 3
original: My idol image? Who gives a crap about that right now!

title: In Battle 4
original: I've been in plenty of events, but this is the most chaotic venue ever!

title: 4-star Result
original: Doctor, gimme a copy of the combat log for this, I'm gonna clip it for my personal promo! Heheh, Battle Diva Momoka, isn't that so cool!

title: 3-star Result
original: Look, I know this was our hard-earned collective victory and everything, but, um, Doctor, did I take out any enemies by myself? Just show me which ones!

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: I guess I can't just shut my eyes and flail my weapon around... I didn't hit anyone I wasn't supposed to, right?

title: Operation Failure
original: Ngh... screw it, I'm going for broke! D—Doctor, I'm gonna—hold the rear!!!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: This room is spacious! Look how high my bubbles go!

title: Tap
original: Wah! Don't sneak up on me like that!

title: Trust Tap
original: Is the bow on my back straight?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: New Year's is usually my busiest period, but I figured this year I'd break the mold to come see you and Hoshiguma. Feels weird to wish blessings on people and stuff when you're not face to face—hey, I'm kidding, I turned down a lot of good work opportunities to visit Rhodes Island! Couldn't you act a little happier?!

title: Greeting
original: Hi, Doctor! I just had the cuuuuuutest encounter, you wanna hear?

title: Birthday
original: Here's some accessories I made myself, and omiyage from my tour stops, and then there's a letter at the bottom... Why do I know your birthday? Well, I—I only just found out yesterday, that's why all of this is so on-the-fly... You know I have a bad memory.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: On this day of Rhodes Island celebration, I bring some news from Higashi—everything's fine in Mitsukue, and other cities have been sending me offers to perform lately, including you. Doctor, do you think we'll be sharing the good times like this at next year's party?
